parts.text: State five jobs which a Muslim might not do.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe guidance given in Islamic law (shariah) about employment for Muslims.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Analogy (qiyas) is the most useful source of Islamic jurisprudence (fiqh) for today.’
Discuss this statement with reference to different points of view. 
OR

parts.text: Identify five different occasions when a Muslim might perform purification (wudu).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain when it is necessary to perform wudu according to one school of Islamic jurisprudence
(fiqh).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Differences regarding performing wudu are not important.’ Discuss this statement with
reference to different points of view.
